'''Angry goblins''' are [[monster]]s that appear during [[A Soul's Bane]], or afterwards, in [[Tolna's rift]].

During the quest, they can only be killed with the [[anger battleaxe]]. After the quest, they can be fought with any weapon and will count towards a [[Goblins (Slayer assignment)|goblins Slayer assignment]].
